Pr22.Processing

Class Page

  • java.lang.Object
    • Pr22.Processing.Page

  • public class Page
extends java.lang.Object
    Stores the images taken by the DocScanner. Images scanned earlier are also available with the DocScanner.getPage(int) method.

    • Method Detail

      • del

        public Page del(Light light)
         throws General
        Removes a DocImage from the Page. This removal is made only with the current data object. Other calls of DocScanner.getPage(int) method will contain all the scanned images. This removal is used for omitting certain illuminations from an analyzing process.
        Parameters:
        light - Id of the Light to remove.
        Returns:
        This object.
        Throws:
        General
